note: Asserted by the frontend Vitest suite. Financial ratios are existing ALG-9 references; values below are small fixtures, not market quotations.

cases.name: compatible_with_current_uf
cases.why: A closing composition, 25% dividend ratio, 45% total burden ceiling and LTV boundary are compatible.

cases.name: near_above_healthy_dividend
cases.why: A dividend above 25% and at or below 30% is close when the other limits hold.

cases.name: adjustment_when_total_burden_exceeds_limit
cases.why: Total burden above 45% cannot be close even if the dividend itself is at the healthy reference.

cases.name: inapplicable_subsidy_overrides_presentation_not_math
cases.why: An official hypothetical DS1/DS49 amount may close the financing but cannot present an eligible result.

cases.name: projection_requires_enough_distinct_dates
cases.why: Insufficient persisted UF history removes projected UF rather than creating a fallback or explanation.

cases.name: saved_copy_preserves_provenance
cases.why: A derived scenario must freeze its own market and catalogue inputs while retaining its parent reference.

cases.name: ds49_base_reference_is_not_an_award
cases.why: The base amount illustrates capacity impact but an unmet condition remains dominant in the presentation.

cases.name: ds1_variable_amount_stays_a_range
cases.why: A range cannot silently become one applied subsidy amount before a reviewed amount matrix is available.
